title: Error Reduction for One-Sided Randomized Polynomial Time
statement: For all natural numbers $c$ and $d$, every language decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability on members at least $\min\!\left(\frac{2}{3},(n+1)^{-c}\right)$ on inputs of length $n$ is decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability on members at least $1-2^{-((n+1)^d+1)}$.
